import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Find .skip files for agents
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("find /opt/areloria -name '*.skip' 2>/dev/null | xargs ls -la 2>/dev/null | head -20")
print("Skip files:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
